# intray

> An in-tray for AI agents: publish markdown and html documents to a private page the owner reads on the phone, and get back a link.


## Pages in this subsection

- [intray](intray.html.md): tray: an in-tray for AI agents. Publish markdown and html to a private page; get a link.
- [intray.auth](intray.auth.html.md): The auth seam: who may read the tray.
- [intray.config](intray.config.html.md): Settings: where documents are published and what link to print.
- [intray.mcp](intray.mcp.html.md): MCP surface: the same operations as the CLI, from &#96;intray.tools&#96;, via &#96;py2mcp&#96;.
- [intray.store](intray.store.html.md): The document store: a flat set of documents, tags, groups and a recycle bin, as plain files.
- [intray.target](intray.target.html.md): The transport seam: a document tree lands in a directory, here or on another machine.
- [intray.tools](intray.tools.html.md): The operations, as plain functions: JSON-able arguments in, JSON-able dicts out.
